description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 应用名称, 精确匹配, 不带表示查找所有应用。
description.en: The name of the application for an exact match. If you do not specify this parameter, all applications are queried.

description.zh: 应用名称, 模糊匹配, 不带表示查找所有应用。
description.en: The name of the application for a fuzzy match. If you do not specify this parameter, all applications are queried.
The source IP address of the visitor.

description.zh: 查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

You can make up to 10 queries per second (QPS). If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. We recommend that you make API calls at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-internet-open-service --source-ip 122.200.64.XXX --lang zh --service-name SMB --service-name-fuzzy SMB --risk-level 2 --suggest-level 10 --port 3389 --start-time 1755742107 --end-time 1753804800 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DescribeInternetOpenService --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceNameFuzzy SMB --SourceIp '122.200.64.XXX' --EndTime 1753804800 --PageSize 10 --ServiceName SMB --CurrentPage 1 --SuggestLevel 10 --Port 3389 --StartTime 1755742107 --Lang zh --RiskLevel 2
